q_A: SELECT avg(age) FROM visitor WHERE Level_of_membership <= 4
gold_q_B: SELECT AVG("visitor"."Age") AS "_col_0" FROM "visitor" AS "visitor" WHERE "visitor"."fellowship_classification" <= 4
